text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
And they've crossed the finish line! In
first place,
it's...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooo!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I didn't think you had it in you! That was
a great
run, Dia.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You too, Kita. You've gotten much
better than I
had imagined!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You mean it?! But I still plan on taking
my running
to even greater heights in
the Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm not at all satisfied with my
performance yet
either.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I've always been chasing after the two of
you, and McQueen as well, but now I
feel like we're finally
on the same
starting line.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Good for you. Both of you.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I can see your desire to defeat us
glowing in those
eyes. I like it.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
You kinda remind me of myself when I
was
younger.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I do?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. I really looked up to Prez back
then... I
competed in the Twinkle Series
in the hopes of
one day surpassing her.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
And then, when it came time to
challenge her
directly...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
She went from my idol to my rival. I
wanted to
defeat her at any cost.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I kinda got the vibe that you two might
be feeling
the same way I did back then!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But you better realize that I haven't lost
my
appetite for a challenge.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Seeing the way you two run has me fired
up to
show you my full strength!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'm ready to throw down the gauntlet in
the Arima
Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: You better be ready for me!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I will be!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll do my best!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I've seen two ways illustrious racers
conduct
themselves...)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(McQueen valiantly accepts challenges
from
others, while Teio embodies the
role of a fierce
challenger.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (So what about me?)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I won a G1 race for the Satono family...
I
overcame the jinx and seized victory.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(I chased after Kita and raced against
her in the
Twinkle Series.)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: (I've got it!)

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After a long silence, Satono Diamond
begins to
speak with a determined look
on her face.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'd like to continue taking on new
challenges.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I've challenged myself with various
goals time and again to get this far.
Breaking the jinx holding back the
Satono family... Chasing after
Kita...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
That's why I think being the kind of
illustrious runner who takes on all kinds
of challenges is the
best path for me to
take.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Challenging McQueen and Teio was my
first step towards that path—the first
new page of my
contribution to the
annals of the Satono family.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
By facing all kinds of challenges, I want
to carve out a place for myself in the
history of both the
Satono family and
the world of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Which brings me to say—my desire to
compete
overseas has been rekindled.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'm not doing it to prove it's possible.
It's
simply
what I want to do.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I want to win an overseas race and etch
the
Satono family name into
Umamusume history.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
By doing so, I hope to break new ground
for both
my family and for all the
Umamusume racing in
Japan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I think that is how I can contribute to the world of Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I have!
choice_data_list: So you've found your answer, then.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
This is the kind of illustrious racer
that I
wish to
be. I know what I need to strive
for now.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
First up—I'm going to win the Arima
Kinen and
join the ranks of the most
illustrious racers!
